_readme: S701, 2026-11-22, #3655 (collection first, r-collection-first-sam-2026-11-20): Santa Ana College's credit course descriptions, so its credit subject codes carry the catalog's own subject heading on the Subjects page. The 2026-27 catalog PDF (506 pages), pages 1 to 406, each page printed whole and unfolded: the table of contents names where the credit course list opens, and the credit list ends on page 405 (406 is the campus map; santa_ana_sce_probe). One load of the PDF; the job log is read back whole with gh. No model call.

questions.courses: Each credit course's code, title, units, hours, requisites and description, line for line, under its subject heading.
